name: abuluyan_select
using:
((local_id IN ( SELECT my_finance_locals.local_id
   FROM my_finance_locals)) OR (local_id IN ( SELECT my_oversight_locals.local_id
   FROM my_oversight_locals)) OR is_admin())

name: abuluyan_update_draft_only
using:
((status = 'Draft'::record_status) AND (local_id IN ( SELECT my_finance_locals.local_id
   FROM my_finance_locals)))
